Oud is one of the most talked-about notes in perfume: deep, woody and a little smoky. Designer houses such as Tom Ford, Gucci, Guerlain and Chopard each have their own take on it. Here is what oud is, how the best-known oud perfumes differ, and how to choose and wear one.

What is oud?

Oud, also called agarwood or aoud, is a dark, fragrant resin that forms in the wood of agar (Aquilaria) trees. It has been treasured in the Middle East and South Asia for centuries, burned as incense and worn as an oil. Natural oud is rare, so many modern perfumes use an oud accord: a blend of woods, resins and leathery notes built to give the same rich effect. Gucci, for example, lists an oud accord in its base notes.

Tom Ford Oud Wood

Tom Ford Oud Wood Eau de Parfum (30ml or 50ml) is the gentlest way into oud. Its key notes are oud wood, rosewood and cardamom over sandalwood, vetiver, tonka bean and amber, so the oud reads smooth and warm rather than smoky. It is unisex and easy to wear in the office or in the evening. See every Tom Ford fragrance, or read our Tom Ford perfume guide for Black Orchid, Noir Extreme and Neroli Portofino.

Gucci Intense Oud

Gucci Intense Oud Eau de Parfum (90ml) is darker. Black pepper and olibanum (frankincense) open it; amber woods, sandalwood and cedarwood sit at the heart; leather, patchouli, gurjun balsam and the oud accord form the base. Expect incense and leather more than sweetness. Shop all Gucci, or compare it with Bloom, Flora Gorgeous and Guilty in our Gucci perfume guide.

Tom Ford Oud Wood or Gucci Intense Oud?

  • Choose Oud Wood if you want a soft, creamy wood with a touch of spice that suits everyday wear.
  • Choose Intense Oud if you like incense, leather and a bolder, smokier trail for evenings and colder months.

Three more oud perfumes

  • Guerlain Oud Essentiel (125ml): saffron and pelargonium, then rose, oud and cedarwood over leather, frankincense and guaiac wood. A rose-and-leather oud, made unisex.
  • Chopard Oud Malaki (80ml): grapefruit, lavender and artemisia, then tobacco, spices and leather over oud, ambergris and dark woods. Made for men, and the most affordable oud in this guide.
  • Montale Aoud Damascus (100ml): damask rose, aoud and saffron with amber, woods and musk. Montale is known for rose and oud, and this one is made for women.

The Al Haramain Amber Oud editions

Al Haramain's Amber Oud range is a popular Arabian line, but read the notes: not every edition is built around oud. Our Amber Oud editions guide compares them all. Armaf Club de Nuit Intense, with agarwood (oud) in its base, is in our Armaf Club de Nuit guide. Amber Oud White Edition is bergamot and orange, then jasmine, rose and freesia over musk, vanilla and patchouli, and is listed for women. Amber Oud Carbon Edition is a fresh, aromatic men's scent of lavender, rosemary, bergamot, sage and vetiver. Amber Oud Bleu Edition is citrus and mint over incense, vetiver and sandalwood. For the Gold, Ruby, Tobacco and Black editions, and for Lattafa, read our guide to Arabian perfume and Lattafa Khamrah Qahwa.

Which oud perfume suits you?

  • New to oud: Tom Ford Oud Wood, or a fresher Amber Oud edition.
  • You love incense and leather: Gucci Intense Oud or Guerlain Oud Essentiel.
  • You love rose: Montale Aoud Damascus or Guerlain Oud Essentiel.
  • Warm and spicy: Chopard Oud Malaki.

Oud is traditionally unisex, so "for men" or "for women" on the label is only a starting point. Browse unisex perfume, perfume for men and perfume for women.

How to wear oud

  1. Start small: one or two sprays. Oud notes are rich, and a little goes a long way.
  2. Apply to moisturised skin on the wrists, neck or chest. Our guide to layering oud with body butter explains why.
  3. Let it settle: do not rub your wrists together. Oud perfumes often change a lot after the first half hour, so judge them later in the day.
  4. Test before you buy a full bottle if you can, or start with a smaller size.

Good to know

  • Eau de parfum is the most common strength for oud perfumes; read extrait vs eau de parfum for what the label means.
  • Patch test on your inner arm if you have sensitive skin, and keep perfume away from your eyes.
  • Store bottles away from heat and sunlight, with the cap on.

Shop every oud perfume, all Arabian perfume and niche perfume, all 100% authentic and dispatched from the UK.

A mini perfume set is a box of small bottles, usually 4ml to 15ml each, from one perfume house. It lets someone try several scents before buying a full bottle, keep a favourite in their bag, or simply enjoy a little collection. Here is what is inside the miniature sets we stock, starting with Jimmy Choo and Dior.

Why choose a mini perfume set?

  • To try before buying: wear each scent for a day or two and see which one you reach for.
  • For travel and handbags: small bottles take up little room.
  • As a gift when you are not sure of their taste: several scents from a house they like is a safer bet than one full bottle.

Sizes vary from set to set, so check the millilitres as well as the number of bottles.

Jimmy Choo mini perfume set

The Jimmy Choo Women’s Miniature Fragrance Gift Set holds five 4.5ml eau de parfums, 22.5ml in all:

  • I Want Choo: peach and mandarin, red spider lily and jasmine, vanilla.
  • Jimmy Choo Eau de Parfum: pear, mandarin and green notes, orchid, toffee and patchouli.
  • I Want Choo Forever: rose and bitter almond, cherry, jasmine and vetiver, vanilla, tonka bean, oakmoss and amber.
  • Rose Passion: frangipani and jasmine, coconut milk and orchid, vanilla and sandalwood.
  • I Want Choo Le Parfum: blackberry, pear and gardenia, jasmine, patchouli and ambrette, praline, sandalwood and moss.

If you already know you love I Want Choo Forever, it also comes as a single 4.5ml miniature. See every Jimmy Choo fragrance.

Dior mini perfume set

The Dior Iconics Mini Perfume Discovery Set has five 5ml minis for women and men: J’adore Eau de Parfum, Miss Dior Eau de Parfum, Miss Dior Eau de Toilette, Hypnotic Poison Eau de Toilette and Sauvage Eau de Toilette. A perfume gift set is the easiest way to give someone a scent they already love, with something extra in the box: a travel spray, a matching body lotion or a few miniatures. This guide is our pick of the perfume gift sets in stock for Christmas 2026, sorted by who you are buying for and what you want to spend. Every set is 100% authentic and shipped from the UK.

How to choose a perfume gift set

  • You know their perfume: buy the set of that scent. A full bottle with a travel spray or lotion costs little more than the bottle alone.
  • You know the brand, not the scent: a miniature set lets them try several perfumes from the same house.
  • You know neither: choose a discovery set, then they can buy the full bottle of the one they like.

Perfume gift sets for her

Full-bottle sets, from the biggest box down:

  • Gucci Bloom Eau de Parfum Gift Set: 100ml eau de parfum, a 10ml travel spray and a 100ml body lotion. A creamy white floral of jasmine and tuberose.
  • Chloé Nomade Gift Set: a 75ml eau de parfum and a 20ml travel spray. Mirabelle plum, freesia and oakmoss, a floral chypre that suits the office as well as an evening out. More in our Chloé perfume guide.
  • Dolce & Gabbana The One for Women Gift Set: two 50ml bottles of a fruity amber floral with peach, lychee, jasmine and vanilla. One for home, one for her bag. Our Dolce & Gabbana perfume guide compares the whole range.

  • Gucci Guilty Pour Femme Gift Set: 50ml eau de parfum with a 50ml body lotion. Lilac, rose and violet over patchouli. Every Gucci scent we stock is in our Gucci perfume guide.
  • Elie Saab Girl of Now Lovely Gift Set: 50ml eau de parfum and a 75ml body lotion, a sweeter scent of red berries, rose, almond and vanilla.

Miniature sets, for trying a whole range: Chloé Women’s Miniature Set (4 x 5ml), Jimmy Choo Women’s Miniature Set (5 x 4.5ml), Marc Jacobs Daisy and Perfect Miniature Set, Dolce & Gabbana Women’s Miniature Set with Devotion, Q, Blue Jasmine, The One and Light Blue, and DKNY Delicious Miniature Set (4 x 7ml). For Mugler Alien and Angel, see our Mugler perfume guide, and for the Narciso Rodriguez 10ml sprays, our Narciso Rodriguez perfume guide. Marc Jacobs Perfect and Daisy are compared in our Marc Jacobs perfume guide.

Aftershave gift sets for him

  • Dior Sauvage Eau de Parfum 100ml + 10ml: bergamot and Sichuan pepper over vanilla and ambroxan. If you only know he likes a fresh, popular scent, this is the safe choice. Our Sauvage EDT vs EDP vs Parfum guide explains the versions.
  • Bvlgari Man Glacial Essence 100ml + 15ml: juniper, ginger and geranium over clean woods. Crisp and easy to wear every day.
  • Bvlgari Man Terrae Essence 100ml + 15ml: citron and calamansi over vetiver, orris and an earthy, resinous base.
  • Bvlgari Man Wood Essence 100ml + 15ml: citrus, coriander, cypress and vetiver, a green woody scent.
  • Azzaro The Most Wanted Intense Gift Set: a 100ml eau de toilette and two 10ml travel sprays, with bergamot, lavender and a moss liquor accord.
  • Dolce & Gabbana K Eau de Parfum 50ml + 5ml: blood orange, lemon and juniper, then sage and lavender over cedarwood.

For a man who likes to switch, the Dolce & Gabbana Men’s Miniature Set holds Devotion, K in two versions, The One and Light Blue Pour Homme. More in aftershave gift sets for him. Choosing between 1 Million, Invictus and Phantom? See our Paco Rabanne perfume guide, or for Versace Eros, our Versace perfume guide.

Discovery sets for anyone

When you do not know their taste, a discovery set is the kindest gift. Dior Iconics Mini Set (5 x 5ml) has J’adore, Miss Dior, Hypnotic Poison and Sauvage. Hermès Miniature Set (4 x 7.5ml) holds four unisex scents from the Jardins collection. Chopard Gardens of Paradise (4 x 10ml) holds Orange Mauresque, Miel d’Arabie, Jasmin Moghol and Rose Seljuke, and Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo (3 x 12ml) three bright Mediterranean scents. Tom Ford perfume covers a wide range, from dark, velvety evening scents to bright citrus colognes. Here are the Tom Ford fragrances we stock, what is in each one, when to wear it, and a few other scents in a similar mood if you want to compare.

Signature and Private Blend

Tom Ford's perfumes fall into two main lines. The Signature collection includes Black Orchid and Noir Extreme. The Private Blend collection includes Oud Wood, Neroli Portofino and Ébène Fumé, and is usually sold in smaller bottles at a higher price. Both are made for anyone to wear: "for men" on a label is only a guide.

Tom Ford Black Orchid

Tom Ford Black Orchid Parfum (100ml) is dark and rich. It opens on truffle and plum, moves into rum, ylang-ylang and black orchid, and settles on patchouli. It is an amber floral, made unisex, and best for evenings, special occasions and the colder months. The parfum is a stronger concentration than eau de parfum, so one or two sprays are plenty.

Tom Ford Noir Extreme

Tom Ford Noir Extreme Parfum (100ml) is warm and spicy-sweet. Cardamom, nutmeg, saffron, mandarin and neroli open it; rose, jasmine, orange blossom and kulfi, a milky, dessert-like accord, form the heart; vanilla, amber, sandalwood and woods make the base. It is made for men and suits evenings and cooler weather.

Tom Ford Neroli Portofino

Tom Ford Neroli Portofino Eau de Parfum (50ml) is the bright one. Italian bergamot, mandarin and Sicilian lemon lead into Tunisian neroli, orange flower and lavender, over a light base of amber and rosemary. It is unisex and easy to wear in the daytime, at work and on holiday.

Ébène Fumé and Oud Wood

Tom Ford Ébène Fumé (50ml) is smoky and woody: palo santo and black pepper, then rose and leather, over ebony wood and resin. Tom Ford Oud Wood (30ml or 50ml) is smoother: oud wood, rosewood and cardamom over sandalwood, vetiver, tonka bean and amber. For more on oud, read our oud perfume guide.

Which Tom Ford perfume suits you?

  • Fresh and easy for daytime: Neroli Portofino.
  • Warm, spicy and sweet: Noir Extreme.
  • Dark, rich and dramatic: Black Orchid.
  • Smoky and woody: Ébène Fumé, or the softer Oud Wood.

The season helps too. Neroli Portofino suits spring and summer, while Black Orchid, Noir Extreme, Ébène Fumé and Oud Wood come into their own in autumn and winter. Many people keep one fresh and one warm scent and switch as the weather changes.

Other scents in a similar mood

These are different perfumes, not copies, but they share some of the same notes:

  • If you like Neroli Portofino's citrus: Acqua di Parma Colonia Pura (20ml), with bergamot, orange and petitgrain over jasmine, coriander, musk and cedarwood. Our Acqua di Parma guide covers the rest of the range.
  • If you like Noir Extreme's spice and vanilla: Joop! Homme Le Parfum (75ml), with lavender and cinnamon, orange blossom and tonka bean, then vanilla, amber and woods.
  • If you like Black Orchid's rum and depth: Bvlgari Man in Black (100ml), with rum, spices and tobacco, leather, tuberose and iris, over guaiac wood, benzoin and tonka bean.

How to wear it

  1. Start with one or two sprays on the neck or wrists; parfums and eau de parfums are concentrated.
  2. Spray on moisturised skin so the scent has something to sit on: see our guide to layering perfume with body butter.
  3. Let it settle before you judge it. The base notes come through after the first half hour.

Good to know

  • Parfum vs eau de parfum: read extrait vs eau de parfum for what the labels mean.
  • Sizes: Black Orchid and Noir Extreme come in 100ml bottles, Neroli Portofino and Ébène Fumé in 50ml, and Oud Wood in 30ml or 50ml.
  • Gifting? Tom Ford makes a generous present; see our Christmas gift guide.
  • Store bottles away from heat and sunlight, with the cap on.

Shop every Tom Ford fragrance, all perfume for men, unisex perfume and niche perfume, all 100% authentic and dispatched from the UK.
